verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents several in-product AI features built on incident data. These include AI-generated incident summaries created at declaration and tailored by audience, Copilot suggestions that compare ongoing incidents to past ones in Command Center and Slack, AI-drafted retrospectives that analyze the incident timeline, and AI capture of meeting and Zoom insights. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality, and deeper documentation of how Copilot suggestions work (only one brief mention).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: FireHydrant's Copilot proactively compares ongoing incidents to your existing and previous incidents and makes suggestions in the Command Center and Slack.
Dive into incidents with AI-generated summaries that provide a clear, concise overview of the situation.
When you click "Draft with AI" next to any question in your retrospective template, FireHydrant will: Analyze the incident's timeline, details, and context
AI-Drafted Retrospectives generate a comprehensive draft that includes a structured overview of the incident, timelines, impacts, and preliminary Lessons Learned.
Our AI captures essential Zoom chat insights, ensuring you're always in the loop.
